name: game-dev-character-model
description: Create a realistic, AAA-looking 3D character model for a game or web scene, from a description or a reference video/image, as a textured, rigged GLB standing in a relaxed pose in a lit three.js viewer. Covers designing an original character, the photoreal A-pose concept image, image-to-3D with Meshy or Tripo through Fil, rigging, posing in code, hangar-style lighting, headless capture, and the checks before showing it.
